_description: Complete reference catalog of n8n nodes with typeVersions, full parameter examples, and credential formats. Agents MUST check doc_url when unsure about params. EVERY node MUST have typeVersion — n8n shows question-mark icons without it.
_self_update_instructions: Run /n8n-discover to add new nodes from instance. Run /n8n-update-docs <type> to refresh params from docs.n8n.io. If a node is missing, web search: 'n8n <name> node documentation site:docs.n8n.io'
_important: ALWAYS include typeVersion when building workflow JSON. See docs/nodes/workflow-template.json for complete examples.

webhook.notes: Only 1 webhook per path+method. Test URL: /webhook-test/<path>. Production: /webhook/<path>

schedule.notes: Uses GENERIC_TIMEZONE env var for timezone

manual.notes: For testing only. Not usable in production workflows.

errorTrigger.notes: Catches errors from other workflows. Set as error workflow in workflow settings. Outputs error details: message, stack, node name, execution ID.

n8nTrigger.notes: Triggered by n8n instance events. Useful for monitoring workflow lifecycle.

chatTrigger.notes: Provides a chat UI. Used as trigger for AI Agent workflows. Outputs user message as chatInput.

httpRequest.credentials: varies (httpHeaderAuth, httpBasicAuth, httpDigestAuth, httpQueryAuth, oAuth1Api, oAuth2Api, or predefined service credential)
httpRequest.notes: Most versatile node. Supports ALL auth types (Header, Basic, Digest, Query, OAuth1, OAuth2, predefined). Send JSON/form/binary bodies. Custom headers. Query params. Pagination. Proxy. Timeout. Batching. Binary file upload/download.

code.notes: Code v2 uses 'language' param (NOT 'mode'). Access input via $input.all() or $input.first(). Return array of { json: {} } objects. Available globals: $input, $env, $execution, $workflow, $now, $today, $jmespath.

set.notes: Set/edit fields on items. Assignments is an object containing an 'assignments' array. Each assignment has id, name, value, type.

if.notes: Output 0 = true branch, Output 1 = false branch. In connections, main[0] array = true targets, main[1] array = false targets.

switch.notes: Multiple output branches. Each rule creates 1 output. Optional fallback output for unmatched items.

merge.notes: Merge data from 2 inputs. Has 2 input connectors. Append = combine all items. Combine = join by field. ChooseBranch = pick one input.

splitInBatches.notes: Output 0 = batch items (connect to processing). Output 1 = done (all batches processed). Loop: connect processing output back to this node's input.

wait.notes: Pauses execution. Execution shows as 'waiting' status.

noOp.notes: No operation. Useful as placeholder or to end a branch cleanly.

respondToWebhook.notes: Use with Webhook node set to responseMode='responseNode'. Sends custom HTTP response. Must be downstream of a Webhook trigger.

stopAndError.notes: Stops execution with an error. Error is caught by Error Trigger in error workflow.

crypto.notes: Hash, HMAC, sign data, or generate random values (UUID, password).

dateTime.notes: Format, calculate, or compare dates. Uses Luxon date format strings.

html.notes: Extract data from HTML using CSS selectors, or generate HTML templates.

spreadsheetFile.notes: Read/write CSV, XLSX, ODS files. Input: binary data. Output: JSON items or binary file.

rssFeedRead.notes: Read RSS/Atom feeds. Returns items with title, link, description, pubDate.

executeCommand.notes: Execute shell commands on the n8n server. Returns stdout, stderr, exitCode.

blocksUi.notes: Block Kit JSON for rich messages

googleSheets.notes: Read, append, update, delete rows. Supports auto-mapping input data to columns.

parameters.query: SELECT * FROM users WHERE status = 'active' LIMIT 100
SELECT * FROM orders WHERE created_at > NOW() - INTERVAL 1 DAY

awsS3.notes: All AWS nodes share the same 'aws' credential type.

ai._description: AI/LangChain nodes. These use the @n8n/n8n-nodes-langchain package prefix, NOT n8n-nodes-base.

text.notes: Input text prompt, usually from chatInput

agent.inputs: 1 main + sub-node connectors (ai_languageModel, ai_tool, ai_memory, ai_outputParser)
agent.notes: Root AI node. Connect LLM sub-node (like OpenAI Chat Model) to ai_languageModel input. Connect tools to ai_tool input. Uses Chat Trigger as trigger.

lmChatOpenAi.notes: Sub-node. Connect to Agent or Chain node's ai_languageModel input. Not used standalone.

chainLlm.notes: Simpler than Agent. Takes a prompt, sends to connected LLM, returns response. Connect OpenAI Chat Model to ai_languageModel input.

_connection_rules.trigger_must_be_first: Every workflow MUST start with exactly 1 trigger node
_connection_rules.outputs_to_inputs: Connect output of node A to input of node B to create flow
_connection_rules.if_has_two_outputs: IF node: output 0 = true (main[0]), output 1 = false (main[1])
_connection_rules.merge_has_two_inputs: Merge node requires exactly 2 input connections
_connection_rules.position_grid: Nodes are positioned on a grid. X increases left-to-right (step ~200). Y increases top-to-bottom (step ~100)
_connection_rules.branching_connection_format: For IF/Switch nodes with multiple outputs: { "IF Node": { "main": [ [{ "node": "TrueTarget", "type": "main", "index": 0 }], [{ "node": "FalseTarget", "type": "main", "index": 0 }] ] } }
_connection_rules.ai_sub_nodes: AI sub-nodes (like lmChatOpenAi) connect via special connectors: ai_languageModel, ai_tool, ai_memory, ai_outputParser — NOT via main connections
